text_en: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from defeating the Amalekites, David remained two days in Ziklag.
text_cn: 撒乌耳死后，达味击杀阿玛肋克人回来，在漆刻拉格住了两天。

text_en: On the third day, a man came from Saul’s camp, with his clothes torn and dirt on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the ground and did obeisance.
text_cn: 第三天，有个人从撒乌耳营中跑来，衣服撕烂，满头灰尘，来到达味前，伏地叩拜。

text_en: David said to him, “Where have you come from? ” He said to him, “I have escaped from the camp of Israel. ”
text_cn: 达味问他说：“你从哪里来？”他答说：“我从以色列营中逃命而来。”

text_en: David said to him, “How did things go? Tell me! ” He answered, “The army fled from the battle, but also many of the army fell and died; and Saul and his son Jonathan also died. ”
text_cn: 达味又问他说：“战事怎样？请告诉我！”他答说：“军民从战场上逃跑了，许多人阵亡，撒乌耳和他的儿子约纳堂也死了。”

text_en: Then David asked the young man who was reporting to him, “How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan died? ”
text_cn: 达味问那报信的少年人说：“你怎么知道撒乌耳和他的儿子约纳堂死了呢？”

text_en: The young man reporting to him said, “I happened to be on Mount Gilboa; and there was Saul leaning on his spear, while the chariots and the horsemen drew close to him.
text_cn: 那报信的少年人答说：“我无意中来到基耳波亚山上，看见撒乌耳伏在自己的枪上，战车和骑兵都快要迫近他。

text_en: When he looked behind him, he saw me, and called to me. I answered, ‘Here sir. ’
text_cn: 他转身见了我，就招呼我。我答说：我在这里。

text_en: And he said to me, ‘Who are you? ’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite. ’
text_cn: 他问我说：你是谁？我答说：我是阿玛肋克人。

text_en: He said to me, ‘Come, stand over me and kill me; for convulsions have seized me, and yet my life still lingers. ’
text_cn: 他向我说：来我身边，杀了我吧！我现在虽还完全活着，但十分晕眩。

text_en: So I stood over him, and killed him, for I knew that he could not live after he had fallen. I took the crown that was on his head and the armlet that was on his arm, and I have brought them here to my lord. ”
text_cn: 我就来到他身边，明知他倒下后，决不能生存，便杀了他；取下他头上的王冠，腕上的手镯，带到这里来奉献给我主。”

text_en: Then David took hold of his clothes and tore them; and all the men who were with him did the same.
text_cn: 达味就抓住自己的衣服撕破了；同他在一起的人也照样作了。

text_en: They mourned and wept, and fasted until evening for Saul and for his son Jonathan, and for the army of the Lord and for the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.
text_cn: 大家为撒乌耳和他的儿子约纳堂，以及上主的百姓和以色列的家族，举哀痛哭，禁食直到晚上，哀悼他们丧身刀下。

text_en: David said to the young man who had reported to him, “Where do you come from? ” He answered, “I am the son of a resident alien, an Amalekite. ”
text_cn: 达味又问那报信的少年说：“你是哪里的？”他答说：“我是阿玛肋克侨民的儿子。”

text_en: David said to him, “Were you not afraid to lift your hand to destroy the Lord ’s anointed? ”
text_cn: 达味向他说：“怎么你不怕伸手杀害上主的受傅者？”

text_en: Then David called one of the young men and said, “Come here and strike him down. ” So he struck him down and he died.
text_cn: 达味遂叫一个少年人来，向他说：“前来，杀了他！”少年人把他一刀砍死了。

text_en: David said to him, “Your blood be on your head; for your own mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have killed the Lord ’s anointed. ’”
text_cn: 同时达味对他说：“你的血应归在你头上，因为你亲口作供说：我杀死了上主的受傅者。”

text_en: David intoned this lamentation over Saul and his son Jonathan.
text_cn: 事后，达味作了这首哀歌，追悼撒乌耳和他的儿子约纳堂，

text_en: (He ordered that The Song of the Bow be taught to the people of Judah; it is written in the Book of Jashar. ) He said:
text_cn: 命令犹大子弟学习这首哀歌，这歌载在“壮士书”上：

text_en: Your glory, O Israel, lies slain upon your high places! How the mighty have fallen!
text_cn: “以色列的荣华，倒在你的高岗上；英雄怎会阵亡？

text_en: Tell it not in Gath, proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon; or the daughters of the Philistines will rejoice, the daughters of the uncircumcised will exult.
text_cn: 不要在加特报告，不要在阿市刻隆街市宣扬，免得培肋舍特的女子欢乐，免得未受割损者的女郎雀跃！

text_en: You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew or rain upon you, nor bounteous fields! For there the shield of the mighty was defiled, the shield of Saul, anointed with oil no more.
text_cn: 基耳波亚山，不祥的山野！在你那里露不再降，雨不再下！因为英雄的盾牌，受了亵渎，撒乌耳的盾牌，那傅油者的武器。

text_en: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan did not turn back, nor the sword of Saul return empty.
text_cn: 对伤者的血，英雄的脂油，约纳堂的弓总不后转，撒乌耳的剑决不空还。

text_en: Saul and Jonathan, beloved and lovely! In life and in death they were not divided; they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
text_cn: 撒乌耳与约纳堂，相亲相爱，生相聚，死不离，神速过鹰，勇猛胜狮。

text_en: O daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you with crimson, in luxury, who put ornaments of gold on your apparel.
text_cn: 以色列女郎！应痛悼撒乌耳，他给你们披上了愉快的紫衣，在你们衣服上点缀了金饰。

text_en: How the mighty have fallen in the midst of the battle! Jonathan lies slain upon your high places.
text_cn: 英雄怎会在战斗中阵亡！哎，约纳堂！对你的死，我极度哀痛！

text_en: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan; greatly beloved were you to me; your love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.
text_cn: 我的兄弟约纳堂，我为你万分悲伤！你爱我之情，何等甜蜜！你对我的爱，胜于妇女之爱。

text_en: How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war perished!
text_cn: 英雄怎会阵亡！战争的武器怎会丧亡！”
